categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains an order issued by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media that amends a previous gazette notification by adding specific articles to Schedule III with corresponding HS codes and concessionary rates. The content focuses on regulatory changes to taxation and import/export classifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
